en.hubeali: H 14938 – A number of our companions, Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mahraan, from Sayf Bin Umeyra, from Basheer Al-Nabaal, from Humraan Bin Ayn who said:
I said to Abu Ja’farasws, ‘The people are saying the earth would fold up for us at night, how it would fold up?’ Heasws said: ‘Like this’, then folded hisasws cloth’.
en.sarwar: 491. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammaad Bin Usman, who has narrated the following:
Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said: ‘The earth folds up during the end of the night’.
